extra.message: Broken access control: `getByName` retrieves a Comment directly via `client.fetch(Comment.class, name)` without applying the visibility checks implemented in `populateVisibleListOptions` (deletionTimestamp, spec.approved, spec.hidden, owner/permission). It is reachable anonymously through `CommentFinderEndpoint.getComment` (`GET /apis/api.halo.run/v1alpha1/comments/{name}`) at CommentFinderEndpoint.java:222-227 and through the theme `commentFinder` (CommentFinderImpl.java:27). An unauthenticated attacker who knows or guesses a comment metadata.name can read unapproved, hidden, or soft-deleted comments (content, author, avatar), bypassing moderation and the intended access rules. The list path (`list`) and reply path (`listReply` -> `populateReplyListOptions` -> `populateVisibleListOptions`) do enforce these checks, confirming the omission is an authorization bug, not by design.

cwe: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
